description: Changes who can see a game. public: its chosen sounds show in the site's Community list (Home and Explore), with the owner's @username. private: only the owner sees it; needs a paid plan, and on the free plan the call fails with a message to show the user. Doesn't touch the sounds or spend credits, and calling it again with the same value changes nothing. Only call it when the user asks to lock or open the game.

visibility.description: public (its sounds in the Community list) or private (owner only, paid plan).

name: set_game_visibility
title: Lock or open game
